Wave 34 (Objective 1, hub): confirmed the taint path in the file rather than assuming it matched the discover route — request.nextUrl.origin (reflects the inbound Host / X-Forwarded-Host header) at the old line 75 -> fetch(`${baseUrl}${fullPath}`) at the old line 82, once each for /api/discover, /api/news/feed and /api/artist-jobs, with no validation anywhere between. Replaced with fetchInternalJson keyed on one new frozen entry (newsRssFeed). requestOrigin is now an optional @deprecated unread field, so the taint path ends at the service boundary while the two out-of-lane callers keep compiling.

Wave 34: created lib/news/text-sanitize.ts — the shared decode-then-strip helper the Wave 33 dispositions required. Decode in ONE semicolon-terminated pass (so &lt; stays literal and the js/double-escaping half cannot recur), strip second, then remove any residual < or >, which closes the unpaired-tag case a paired regex structurally cannot. Plus normalizeExternalHttpUrl for third-party links. 17 tests.

The third unflagged SSRF instance is fixed by porting the existing guard, the whole news sanitizer cluster is closed in code, and the systemic lesson turned out to be worth more than either. OBJECTIVE 1: confirmed the taint path in the files rather than assuming it — request.nextUrl.origin at app/api/opportunities/sync/route.ts:13 and app/api/opportunities/route.ts:36 -> ingestOpportunitiesFromRss({ origin }) -> new URL('/api/feed/rss-news', params.origin) at lib/opportunities/rss-opportunities-service.ts:38 -> global fetch() at :41, six times in a categories.map with none of the five transport controls. Closed with a new frozen OPPORTUNITIES_UPSTREAM_ROUTES key and a fetchInternalJson call by key: no second allowlist, allowlist source or transport, and DISCOVER_UPSTREAM_ROUTES left untouched with a new test pinning its exact shape so Wave 33's tests keep meaning what they meant. 19 tests, every rejection path asserting zero sockets, zero DNS and zero upserts. `rg -n "new URL\('/api/" app lib` now returns only prose: the class has no remaining instance. The requestOrigin residual went from two call sites to one — app/api/news/feed/route.ts is clean; app/api/feed/for-you/route.ts:27 is a social-owned shared file and is routed as a one-line handoff rather than edited. OBJECTIVE 2: #40 fixed in app/api/feed/rss-news/route.ts, #41 fixed in lib/opportunities/rss-opportunities-service.ts, #45 fixed in components/news/news-page.tsx, and #42/#46 verified RESOLVED BY DELETION because the design-system lane removed lib/services/rss-feed.service.ts as a zero-importer module in ca3bb0b0. All three discover registry entries confirmed unnecessary against the source, then deleted: 48 lines removed, 0 added, with the 2 integrations and 1 admin entries byte-identical. One real catch: Wave 34's handoff said the CDATA unwrap was 'redundant rather than wrong' before toPlainText, which is backwards — toPlainText treats a CDATA wrapper as markup and would have discarded the payload, and for <link> the payload IS the URL. The unwrap stays in front, and a test pins that. OBJECTIVE 3: swept all three blind-spot classes across the charter surface, and the sweep found THREE live schema drifts that make parts of the news feed silently empty with zero tsc diagnostics, zero test failures and zero CodeQL alerts — artist_blog_posts.format exists only in an ARCHIVED migration, music_tracks' four trust columns are missing from the view's projection though present on its base table, and two personalization tables are created by no migration at all. discover cannot fix any of them; it reverted a one-line 'fix' for the first one that the press lane's own test caught, because deleting the column would have hidden a schema regression as a working feature. What it did fix is the silence: both candidate queries now log the PostgREST error instead of discarding it. The typing root cause is one file, lib/supabase/service-role.ts:11, propagating to 25 un-generic annotations plus 12 `supabase: any` parameters in app/api/feed/posts/route.ts; both are reported with three costed CI options and no cross-repo infrastructure built. Objective 4 is confirmed recorded as a named blocking acceptance criterion, in the blockers, and in the handoff with the exact variables; the release lane has already filed HF-RELEASE-035-INTERNAL-API-ORIGIN-OPERATOR to consume it. NO alert is claimed closed: GHAS has no local engine, and the three SSRF defects were never alerts in the first place, so the grep and the source guards are their honest attestation.

checkpoints.summary: Wave 33 security lane. Confirmed CodeQL #16 independently rather than trusting the dispatch summary: the taint source is `origin` from `new URL(request.url)` at app/api/discover/route.ts:328 (reflects the inbound Host / X-Forwarded-Host header) and the sink is `fetch(`${origin}${path}`)` at :351; the path component was separately tainted by the location, creatorType, and service query parameters. No validation or allowlist intervened anywhere between them, so a caller who could set the host header reached internal addresses through the app's own egress. Replaced the transport with an exact-origin allowlist sourced only from server env (no localhost fallback), a frozen key-to-path upstream map, encoding-normalizing address policy (decimal/octal/hex/short IPv4, IPv4-mapped/translated/NAT64/6to4 IPv6, ULA, link-local, CGNAT, metadata, reserved), resolve-then-pin over node:https/node:http with every DNS record range-checked, structural redirect denial (3xx is a hard failure and node:https never follows), a 5s timeout, a 2 MiB response cap, and a JSON content-type requirement. Added 40 negative tests; every rejection path asserts the mocked node:https/node:http were never called. 72 focused discover/search tests pass, focused ESLint clean, scoped tsc clean, security-exception registry validates with 5 entries, agents:validate clean. Triaged 6 discover-charter alerts into 3 registry dispositions, handed off 2 unflagged SSRF-class siblings, and recorded the missing-main-baseline attribution problem as a governance blocker. No alert was dismissed and no hosted evidence is claimed.
